metadata.title: Hook patterns — addiction mechanisms labeled
metadata.description: A short encyclopedia of attention hooks HookLens marks on feeds: infinite scroll, badges, related rabbit holes, autoplay.

hero.title: Name the hooks that keep you scrolling
hero.description: These are attention / addiction mechanisms — not checkout dark patterns. HookLens labels them on the feed; this page is the shared dictionary.

patterns.title: Committed hooks (v0)
patterns.label: Taxonomy
patterns.description: Aligned with the Reddit demo path. Detox behavior is best-effort on live sites.

items.title: Infinite scroll
items.description: No landing, no done — the feed keeps growing. Detox: Feed pause (best effort) banner + try to mute further load.

items.title: Unread / inbox badge
items.description: Red counts and unread chrome that pull you back open. Detox: css-hide the badge chrome.

items.title: Related / continue chrome
items.description: Similar posts and continue modules that start another rabbit hole. Detox: css-grey or hide the module.

items.title: Autoplay / inline video
items.description: Zero decision to continue watching. Opportunistic on a pinned demo URL. Detox: pause video under Twin mode.

items.question: Is this the same as dark-pattern detectors?
items.answer: Cousins only. Those tools hunt checkout tricks (fake timers, confirmshaming). This list is habit machinery on feeds.

items.question: Will more hooks appear here?
items.answer: Yes — ranking chrome and variable-reward drip are stretch items after the Reddit twin demo is solid.
